entities.name: Olga Scheinpflugová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olga Scheinpflugová was a Czech actress and writer. She was a daughter of the writer, journalist and playwright Karel Scheinpflug. In 1935, she married the writer Karel Čapek.
